issues.detail: The Hebrew 'תְּשַׂגְשֵׂגִי' means 'you cause to flourish' or 'you make thrive' (from the root שׂגשׂג, to grow luxuriantly), not 'rào đâm chồi' (you fence/sprout). The Vietnamese adds 'rào' (fence) which is not in the Hebrew and changes the meaning.

The Hebrew 'נֵד קָצִיר' means 'a heap of harvest' (i.e., a harvest heap), not 'mùa gặt bị tiêu tan' (the harvest is destroyed). The Vietnamese adds 'bị tiêu tan' (is destroyed) which is not present in the Hebrew; the Hebrew simply says 'a heap of harvest' in the day of grief and incurable pain.
